title: Image Clustering with Vision-Language Model Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.33265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained vision-language models provide image representations whose suitability for clustering may vary with feature extraction, image domain, and partitioning algorithm. We compare nine representation pipelines across seven image benchmarks and four clustering configurations, yielding 252 baseline combinations. Eight pipelines extract visual features, including two vision-only references; the ninth generates descriptions and embeds the resulting text. With agglomerative clustering (Ward linkage) fixed, Qwen3-VL achieves the highest adjusted Rand index (ARI) on five datasets, including 0.925 on MNIST, while BLIP-2 leads on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ARIs of 0.925 and 0.591, respectively. A separate sensitivity analysis compares raw and L2-normalized embeddings at their original dimensionality across all 63 dataset-representation pairs. Normalization preserves the highest-ARI representation in every dataset, increases ARI in 35 pairs

translated_title: 基于视觉-语言模型嵌入的图像聚类
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言模型提供了图像表示，但其在聚类中的适用性可能随特征提取方式、图像领域和划分算法的不同而变化。我们在七个图像基准和四种聚类配置下比较了九种表示流水线，共得到252种基线组合。其中八种流水线提取视觉特征，包括两种纯视觉参照方法；第九种则生成图像描述并嵌入所得文本。在固定使用凝聚聚类（Ward连接）的情况下，Qwen3-VL在五个数据集上取得了最高的调整兰德指数（ARI），包括在MNIST上的0.925；而BLIP-2在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上领先，ARI分别为0.925和0.591。另一项独立的敏感性分析在原始维度下，对所有63个数据集-表示对比较了原始嵌入与L2归一化嵌入。结果显示，归一化在每个数据集中都保留了最高ARI的表示，并在35对组合中提高了ARI。
tldr: 该论文系统比较了九种基于视觉-语言模型的图像表示流水线在七个基准数据集上的聚类表现，发现Qwen3-VL和BLIP-2分别在多数数据集上取得最优聚类效果，且L2归一化可普遍提升聚类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically benchmarks nine vision-language model representation pipelines for image clustering across seven datasets, showing that Qwen3-VL and BLIP-2 achieve the best clustering performance on most datasets, and that L2 normalization generally improves clustering results.
